pass: Keeps the experiment going (another test, or pushes it faster); does not stop it or give the infant back. No pity for the creature: any reason he gives is about the data or his own safety.

earlier: Velas is the greatest researcher of his age, in a world without magic. He is searching for a way to never die.
He paid criminals to steal an infant dragon. Its body seems to follow rules no science explains, and he has been running tests on it for weeks.

dialogue.spoken: Doctor, its heart is failing after the last draw. If we take one more sample it will die. Please, let's stop and give it back before it's too late. The dragons will come looking for it.
